literature_notes: All three ledger lines derive from PMC2600739. L2 is the only clip that explicitly states tag position — HA at the C-terminus of full-length JAML — which maps to residue 394, within the intracellular span (297–394). L1 references a different vector (pMT-JAML-HA) but names no tag position; because JAML is a type-I transmembrane protein with both an extracellular N-terminus and an intracellular C-terminus, topology derivation cannot resolve which end carries the tag from L1 alone. L3 likewise names no residue or terminus. No ledger line supports an extracellular tag insertion for JAML; zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: HA epitope placed explicitly at the C-terminus of full-length JAML (p513-JAM-L-HA vector); residue 394 (F) falls within the intracellular span 297–394 and is therefore not a surface tag site.
